implication: Formal directories massively under-count (sector ~1,000 firms, ~40% injection); most molders are informal/Ouedkniss/Facebook-visible only.

summary: Kompass DZ lists 9 companies for injection/blow molds across Alger, Annaba, Boumerdès, El Oued, Sétif; Master Mill Precision (Kouba) designs and makes injection molds for medical/pharma/food
implication: Formal mold-making base is thin; Annaba and El Oued have at least one each.

summary: Ouedkniss mold-service listings include HIGHPARTS-DIESEL INJECTION (Dar El Beida, ~82 items) and EURL JET BLEU MACHINE (Mezloug, Sétif); earlier notes found listings in Dar El Beida, Blida, Kouba, Sétif, Oued Smar
implication: Many informal moulistes can copy/repair molds cheaply - both a resource and a copying risk.

summary: Algeriejob ad: 'Technicien en moulage par injection' in Blida - adjusts injection machines, follows production, writes reports; 2+ yrs, Bac+2
implication: Régleurs are recruited at Bac+2 with 2+ yrs; Blida competes for them.

summary: Algeriejob ad seeks setters for plastic injection OR aluminium machines in BBA, 2-5+ yrs (employer unnamed; matches MIRAF's dual activity, unconfirmed)
implication: BBA has active demand for setters; poaching risk for a startup.

summary: Smart Pack (Ouled Moussa) recruits confirmed injection/blow operator, 3-5 yrs, CDI; tasks include first-level maintenance
implication: Operators expected to do level-1 maintenance; skilled labour pool exists East of Algiers.

summary: Optimal Packaging Solutions (Blida) recruits industrial maintenance engineer for injection and thermoforming machines
implication: Maintenance skills are scarce enough that firms advertise for engineers.

summary: Emploitic has a search page for 'ingénieur ajusteur régleur des machines à injection plastique'; algeriejob CV base contains plastics setter profiles with 5-10 yrs, Bac+2 'technologie de l'industrie plastique'
implication: A trained setter pool exists (vocational diploma); hire one experienced régleur as key person.

summary: No identifiable independent injection-machine repair technician/company was found; Arabic/French repair searches returned generic results; Ouedkniss repair listings blocked
implication: Field check needed: ask AFC, 2M Expert, SNK and local molders which freelance technicians they use.

summary: State GPI auto plastics plant opened; molds to be on site before end-2026; import ban on locally makeable auto plastic parts from 2027
implication: GPI will absorb skilled setters/mold techs nationally in 2027; also possible Tier-2 buyer.

summary: PTD (Blida) is Algeria's 2nd largest preform maker with caps; SGT Algérie runs 16 preform presses in Rouiba and cap sites in Sétif
implication: Closures/preforms are scale-dominated; avoid.

summary: TikTok discover page 'مصنع بلاستيك في سطيف العلمة' exists, indicating El Eulma plastic factories market themselves on short video
implication: Competitor scouting should include TikTok/Facebook, not only directories; and the founder's own social posts are visible to them.

summary: Customs DG said 60% of goods imported for resale were counterfeit (2011); seizures 2011 mostly cosmetics and sports goods
implication: Old data; shows tolerance of imitation in distribution channels, not plastics-specific.

summary: Ministry of Commerce survey: 40.98% of counterfeit products found were made locally, 41.34% imported, 18% unknown origin; auto spare parts among top counterfeited items
implication: Local manufacturers do produce imitations at scale; any successful branded/standard part will be copied.

summary: Echorouk: 700,000 counterfeit articles seized in 2011, +845%
implication: Enforcement exists but is reactive; IP protection weak.

summary: Algerie360: 'En l'absence d'une réglementation claire, la contrefaçon étouffe les marchés'; Algérie Eco 2018: informal and counterfeit 'gangrènent' the economy; thousands of firms closed due to unfair competition
implication: Do not rely on legal remedies; protect via speed, customer lock-in, mold ownership and NDAs.

summary: Maghreb household-plastics market: basic models saturated, competition on price vs Chinese imports and counterfeits; informal under-priced imports ~15%
implication: Visible consumer products get copied fastest; B2B custom parts tied to a customer's drawing are less exposed.

summary: Several firms combine mold making + molding (MIRAF, SNK, ENPC/SIPLAST+ALMOULES, FMPI) and some advertise making parts 'from models' or reverse engineering (Cumnewtec, Precision Industry spare parts, CDTA)
implication: Anyone shown a part or a mold can replicate it; keep molds in own plant, avoid subcontracting production of own catalogue items to molder-moldmakers.

summary: No forum/social complaint or court case specifically about an Algerian molder copying a customer's or competitor's plastic part was found (search budget and proxy limits)
implication: Treat as unknown, not as low risk; ask in interviews with buyers/molders.

summary: No Algerian supplier of injection robots/pickers, mold temperature controllers or automation integrators specific to plastics was found this session (only AFC 'automation/packaging lines' and FMPI equipment/software)
implication: Auxiliaries likely imported with the machine; plan pickers/chillers in the China order.
